raw.description:
Overview

  • Employment Type: Full-time Independant Contractor
  • Location: Remote - ANYWHERE IN LATAM
  • Compensation: $45,000 - $60,000/year OTE (On-Target Earnings)
  • Compensation Structure: Base Salary + Uncapped Commission

This role requires availability to work Monday through Thursday from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM EST, as well as 4 hours on Friday and 4 hours on Saturday as part of the regular weekly schedule.

Meet LLC Hub

At LLC Hub (a division of GBS Group), we focus on helping entrepreneurs and executives create opportunities by building better businesses. We know that a solid, compliant start is critical for future success, and that's where you come in.

We specialize in Start-Up Services, providing a complete suite of offerings to get new companies compliant and running efficiently, including:

  • Company state registration + EIN Request
  • Registered Agent and Virtual Address services
  • Compliance services like Annual Report Filing and Corporate Obligations Notification
  • Tax support, including Corporate Tax Return Filing and a 30-minute appointment with a Tax Advisor

Our differentiation is our Deep Business Experience and commitment to Find Solutions and Create Simplicity, guiding clients through the complex initial stages with clarity and expertise.

Role

We’re looking for a Sales Representative (Closer) who knows how to consistently show up, follow through, and close deals in a fast-paced sales environment. You will be the primary closer for inbound and warm leads interested in LLC Hub’s Start-Up Services.

This role is ideal for someone who is comfortable following proven sales processes and scripts in both English and Spanish, motivated by closing results, and confident building urgency, handling objections, and guiding prospects through the sales process.

Success in this role requires strong follow-up discipline, resilience, accountability, and the ability to consistently execute daily activity expectations while delivering an excellent client experience.

Your role is to embody GBS Group’s core values — Client First, Kind Candor, and Pursue Growth and Learning — by putting clients first, building genuine rapport, and communicating effectively to ensure every prospect feels valued and understood from the first interaction, while remaining committed to continuous growth and high performance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Daily Activity (Open to Goal Mandate): Execute 8 to 12 calls/meetings per day with qualified prospects. This is a mandatory daily KPI and the expectation for being "Open to Goal" is that work continues until this activity quota is met.
  • Expert Education: Educate prospects on LLC Hub's Start-Up Services and compliance offerings from an expert, consultative perspective.
  • Pipeline Management: Maintain a clear, accurate, and observable pipeline in the CRM. Move all prospects to the proper stage throughout the day.
  • Documentation: Diligently document all interactions with prospects and clients in the CRM notes.
  • Diligence: Follow up diligently and consistently with potential clients over extended periods.
  • Collaboration: Collaborate with the team to ensure smooth transitions from sales to service.

Key Results (KPIs)

These metrics define high performance in this role:

  • Show Rate: Maintain a Show Rate >70% (Percentage of scheduled meetings that actually occur).
  • Close Rate: Maintain a Close Rate >20% (Percentage of meetings converted to sales).
  • Sales Performance: Directly contribute to Sales Revenue and optimizing Sales Cycle Time.
  • Pipeline Hygiene: All prospects are properly moved in the CRM and client information is fully documented by EOD.
  • Follow-Up Consistency: All qualified prospects are consistently followed up with indefinitely.

What We Offer You

  • Compensation: Guaranteed Base Salary + Uncapped Commission. OTE is $45k - $60k.
  • Work Ethic (Open to Goal): We operate with an Open to Goal philosophy. This means that work is driven by daily activity metrics, and the commitment is to meet your mandatory activity KPIs (8-12 calls) regardless of the clock, aligning your effort directly with your uncapped earning potential.
  • Development: Internal training and coaching, leveraging GBS Group's deep business and advisory experience to help you grow rapidly.
  • Work/Life: Flexible Time Off Policy and Company-wide Holidays.

Requirements

  • Experience:
    • 3+ years of high-volume transactional sales experience (e.g., event tickets, gym memberships, subscriptions, or similar B2B/B2C services).
    • 3+ years of direct closing experience in high-volume, short sales cycle environments (same-day close or sales cycles under 30–45 days).
    • Proven ability to handle objections, negotiate, and consistently close deals.
    • Experience selling service-based offerings to inbound and warm leads.
    • Experience with CRM management and pipeline tracking.
  • Communication: Excellent communicator over phone and video conference in Spanish and English, with a great ability to present complex information clearly.
  • Self-Management: Self-sufficient and able to properly manage your own time and an organized sales pipeline.
  • Mindset: Routine driven, open to learning new sales processes, and focused on finding solutions and creating simplicity for our clients.
Salary: $45,000 - $60,000/year OTE (On-Target Earnings)

Summary

Do you love the North Central Coast of California? Are you the go-to person when it comes to planning a night out, always ready with a recommendation for the city’s most seasoned finds and hidden hotspots?

As the Central Coast North California Community Ambassador, you will be a part-time Yelp employee (working out of your home or anywhere with WiFi) at the helm of a vibrant, buzzing community of locals who drink, shop, and play their way through the city via peer recommendations on Yelp.

The Community Ambassador role requires a blend of strong event planning, social media, and marketing skills with the goal of highlighting local businesses and further growing the local Yelp community. Community Ambassadors also spend time engaging with their local Yelp Elite Squad, a group of Yelpers who have gone the extra mile with their content- sharing awesome photos, writing thoughtful reviews, and supporting other Yelpers in the community.

What you'll do:

  • You will be the face of Yelp in your region by attending local events and building relationships with local business owners and community organizers.
  • You will conceptualize, plan, and execute Yelp events in your region.
  • You will engage with your local Yelp Elite squad online and offline, by hosting Yelp Elite events at local businesses and keeping them up to date on the latest happenings in your city.
  • You will be responsible for building Yelp collections for the Local Yelp newsletter, which features weekly themes highlighting the best local businesses to discover.
  • You will manage the day-to-day curation and growth of Yelp’s local social media presence across Instagram and Twitter.

What it takes to succeed:

  • You consider yourself a local expert on all things the Central Coast North,

  • You are willing to connect with business owners to forge relationships and inspire collaboration on behalf of Yelp.

  • You have strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • You thrive in an autonomous environment.

  • Bachelor's Degree (Preferred)

Other Requirements:

  • You live within 30 minutes of Central Coast North (between Santa Maria to Monterey).
  • You are at least 21 years of age and have reliable transportation options.
  • You have the bandwidth and flexibility to work a firm 19 hours per week.
  • While you will not be restricted to only working for Yelp, you may not qualify for the position if there is a conflict of interest, such as: you are a business owner, you are closely affiliated with a business owner, or you work for one of our direct competitors.

  • We expect our Community Ambassadors to be the biggest cheerleaders and role models for their local Yelp Elite Squad. As such, Community Ambassadors must always meet the Elite Squad eligibility requirements and comply with our Elite Terms of Membership.

    Additionally, to maintain Yelp’s integrity and avoid conflicts of interest, our Community Ambassadors are prohibited from accepting any form of compensation in exchange for promoting a company’s goods or services. This includes things like accepting free or discounted gym membership in exchange for promoting the gym on their personal social channels, attending a complimentary dinner in exchange for posting a review online of the restaurant that hosted the dinner and so on.

    By submitting your application for this role, you represent that you have reviewed and understand the information above (including the information contained in the provided links) and will comply with these guidelines if offered the role at Yelp.

(T1) Compensation range for this position is $23.00 - $31.00 per hour.

(T2) Compensation range for this position is $21.00 - $28.00 per hour.

(T3) Compensation range for this position is $18.00 - $24.00 per hour.

raw.description:
Job Title: Analyst - Project, DMC Group

Classification: Full Time, Exempt

Location: Remote or Temecula, CA

Salary Range: $65,000 - $100,000

NBS has standard office hours of Monday through Friday 8 a.m. – 5 p.m. PST with the option to work a Compressed Work Week (9/80) schedule.

Summary:

NBS is currently seeking a Project Analyst in our District Financing Consulting Group. NBS' District Formation Consulting Group works with local government agencies to develop revenue tools. From preliminary analyses such as fiscal impact analysis to formation of assessment and community facilities districts and debt issuance, our team works closely with our clients to find funding and financing solutions that meet the needs of the community. The Analyst plays a critical role in supporting our consulting services by providing analytical support, data management, and reports to our government agency clients. They work closely with team members to provide actionable insights that help public agencies optimize their revenue and ensure compliance with relevant regulations.

Essential functions:

1. Data Collection and Analysis: Gather, clean, and organize data from various sources, ensuring data is accurate and accessible for analysis. Conduct data validation and ensure the accuracy and completeness of data before analysis. Review and manage large datasets, ensuring consistency and integrity throughout the process. Effectively evaluate and interpret financial, accounting, and legal data. Perform regular audits to ensure data integrity and implement corrective actions when necessary.

2. Report Generation and Presentation: Compile findings into clear, well-organized reports and presentations for senior team members and clients. Use data visualization tools to present data in easily understandable formats such as dashboards, charts and graphs. Draft detailed written summaries to accompany reports, explaining methodologies, findings and recommendations. Review and cross-check reports to ensure consistency and quality across all deliverables.

3. Client Support: Develop and maintain professional relationships with clients and their assigned representatives. Provide timely data-driven responses to management and client inquiries during project phases. Assist in client meetings, offering insights or explanations regarding data findings and conclusions. Collaborate with senior team members to ensure client deliverables are met and align with project objectives.

4. Project Coordination and Management: Support the planning, execution, and delivery of consulting projects through tracking and managing assigned tasks, ensuring deadlines are met. Prepare and maintain project documentation and communicate project updates to team members and clients, ensuring alignment and transparency. Identify potential risks, or issues, and escalate them to senior team members for resolution.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • Ability to learn how to analyze and interpret statutes and regulatory codes.
  • Establish and maintain effective client relationships.
  • Possess excellent organization skills and time management skills.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office, specifically Excel.
  • Ability to analyze complex sets of data within various program platforms.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to identify and escalate issues beyond the current level of expertise.
  • Must display attention to detail and to be meticulous and accurate in handling large data sets.
  • Ability to adjust and manage competing priorities.
  • Education may vary; a degree in business, public administration, finance, or IT is preferred.

NBS Benefits:

We offer a full line of benefits including the following:

  • Employee Stock Ownership Program – 100% Employee Owned
  • 401k Plan with a generous employer match
  • Medical and Dental Insurance coverage is paid in full for the employee.
  • Paid Vacation, Sick, Holidays, and Volunteer time.
  • Life insurance covering the employee in the sum of $100,000, is paid in full by NBS.
  • Short- and long-term disability insurance for the employee is paid in full by NBS.

About NBS:

NBS is a consulting firm helping communities fund tomorrow. We typically work directly for government agencies, such as cities, school districts, and special districts, but also consult with a variety of non-profit and private entities. In addition, NBS licenses its proprietary software, called D-FAST®, to local government agencies nationwide. The primary office is in Temecula with a secondary office located in San Francisco. We are a 100% employee-owned company with roughly 55 employees. We have been in business since 1996 and have been growing consistently and responsibly ever since. We pride ourselves in what we do for our communities, as well as our great work environment, growth opportunities, personal and professional development, and excellent benefits.

Salary: $65,000 to $100,000
